purpose: ONE bounded Newton refinement of the classical 4PL marginal ML on Design B (no priors, no MAP/MCMC). Committed before execution.
start: validation/four_pl_rescue/verdict_B.json parameters (R mirt 1.48 BL_GH161, PR #148; projected score 2.757, logLik -179462.838063)
model: P = c + (d - c)/(1 + exp(-a(theta - b))), D = 1, theta ~ N(0,1); bounds a [.1,5], b [-6,6], c [0,.5], d [.5,1]; no priors

prechecks.mapping: R-reported logLik equals common GH161 logLik within 1e-6 (PR #148 metadata)
prechecks.gradient: analytic m12_diagnostic.scores vs central difference of the common logLik (h = 1e-5) on 12 fixed coordinates (items I01, I10, I20 x a,b,c,d): max relative error <= 1e-4, else STOP (no fit)

newton.information: information_audit.information on GH161, step cbrt(eps), symmetrized; active face = coordinates not at a bound with outward score
newton.backtracking: step 0.5^k, k = 0..9; accept the first feasible step with logLik >= previous and projected score < previous
newton.stop: STATIONARY (projected score <= 1e-5) | INFORMATION GATE (min eig <= 0 or condition > 1e8) | STAGNATION (no acceptable step) | BUDGET (elapsed > 15 min before a step)
newton.single_run: no restarts, no alternative starts, no setting changes

recovery: only after NUMERICAL PASS: PR #148 PROTOCOL recovery (RMSE a .15, b .10, c .03, d .03; max |z| <= 4, Wald SE from inverse GH161 information)
not_done: Monte Carlo, SE/CI certification, production switch
